method: Full copied personal config with installed lsp-mode, runtime GC=16000000/0.1, plist decoding, no booster in container. Emacs and PTY driver pinned CPU 0; Python replay pinned CPU 1. Network disabled. Same 64-file project with 16384 retained diagnostics, then 1000 replacement notifications of 256 diagnostics each. Paced 200 notifications/sec and saturated producer. ABBA groups, 3 measured runs each, each group excludes one warmup. Same /bundle path, source/compiler/dependencies; no instrumented execution or new training.
limitations: Synthetic diagnostic replay, not a real language server or complete LSP interaction mix.
100 Hz input probe skips missed slots and records their count; both send-to-ack and scheduled-to-ack delays retained. It is not an open-loop queue of all scheduled keystrokes.
Latency includes PTY/socket acknowledgements and scheduling, not terminal-emulator rendering.
GC timings use gc-elapsed deltas in post-gc-hook; recorded durations are elapsed GC time, not hardware CPU counters.
Asynchronous batching and differing successful input counts can change collection counts; cumulative GC changes do not isolate collector speed.
Six measured sessions per variant/mode; small differences do not establish statistical significance.
